callees.name: _run_generate_phases
callees.signature: _run_generate_phases(proj_dir, work_dir, script_dir, is_incremental, resume, submodules, plugin_stage, plugin_root)
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir, work_dir, and script_dir are valid existing directory paths; is_incremental and resume are booleans; submodules, if not None, is a sequence of subdirectory paths within proj_dir; plugin_stage is a PluginStageConfig or None; plugin_root is a Path or None
callees.post_condition: phases.json is written to the expected location under work_dir, containing a list of phases each with a phase number, name, description, modules, and depends_on_phases

callees.name: _post_process_phases
callees.pre_condition: phases.json exists at the expected path under work_dir; proj_dir is a valid directory; required_source_files, if not None, is a sequence of file paths relative to proj_dir; submodules, if not None, is a sequence of subdirectory paths within proj_dir; one_phase is a boolean
callees.post_condition: Returns True if phases.json was structurally modified (source files deduplicated across phases or merged into a single phase), False otherwise; the final deduplicated phases.json is written to its expected path under work_dir such that every source file is assigned to exactly one phase

callees.name: _run_generate_domain_context
callees.pre_condition: phases.json exists at the expected path under work_dir; proj_dir and script_dir are valid directories; resume is a boolean; plugin_stage is a PluginStageConfig or None; plugin_root is a Path or None
callees.post_condition: engine_overview.txt is written under work_dir/spec_prompts/domain_context/ describing the overall system architecture and invariants; for each phase number defined in phases.json, a corresponding phase_NN_types.txt is written under work_dir/spec_prompts/domain_context/ describing the types, data structures, and invariants for the source files assigned to that phase

callees.name: _setup_outputs_complete
callees.pre_condition: work_dir is a directory containing pipeline output files from the preceding stages
callees.post_condition: Returns True if and only if all of the following exist at their expected paths under work_dir: phases.json, spec_prompts/domain_context/engine_overview.txt, and for every phase number in the current phases.json a corresponding spec_prompts/domain_context/phase_NN_types.txt
